ownerStatement: On 21 November 2026 repeat98 answered “Approve this scoped release” for FM Synth 0.1.5 after reviewing the measured MKII results and the open limits. The owner also reported speaking directly with Tim Hastie and receiving his OK for the idle-cost change. On 23 November 2026 repeat98 answered “yes” when asked to re-sign this approval for the current source: the 22 November rework that keeps the rest, drops the frame-prepare path and cuts the silent track’s cost.
reason: The current USB package is 8cf43bfb (public/octatrack-modules/synth/0.1.5-experimental.mwrm). On the unit only its cost was read: on 22 November 2026 the owner’s MKII with the 0.8 development twin dce1d30e recorded evidence/frame-cost.json (rest 0, first 31.3, each 0.5). The playback edge cases TESTING.md lists for this package were not run on a unit: the frame share with no FM track, with notes, after a released note and across STOP and PLAY, a pick while it rests, GLIDE with a LEG MONO sample track, HOLD after a wake and a legacy FMSYNTH marker project. The MKII results in TESTING.md for the earlier packages b904a852, 2ac17c3a and 5b425a33 are those packages’, not this one’s. Worst-case chip cycles, complete memory bounds, cold-start persistence and sample-locked legacy notes on the unit remain open. UI captures are retained from 0.1.2 because the release keeps the same controls and pages.
